summary: Frontend-only test at 390x844 (pro user test_session_pro_1) of the MaydaySetupDialog follow-up: Boat type, Hull/Deck colour confirm, the boat description in the MAYDAY script, and the 5-second line glow. Everything in the briefing passed on the main boat and on Model Vessel. (1) Colours: with empty hull/deck colours, the hull and deck selects start on 'White' with a yellow Confirm button and no tick. Boat type with a tick and a pencil shows the boat-type-select in the dialog. Choosing 'Choose...' clears the type, removes the tick and the line reads '[BOAT TYPE]'. (2) Clicking hull Confirm saved White to the DB, showed the tick and hid Confirm. The POB line got mbp-glow and data-lit=true; it was still lit at 4.3s and off at 5.8s. Choosing Blue for deck showed the deck tick and lit the same line. (3) Script text: with no colours the line reads '...white Yacht - Sloop. NOTE: If not white state correct colour of boat.' With both White it reads 'There are 3 persons on board POB. The boat is a white Yacht - Sloop.' (no NOTE). With deck Blue it reads '...a Yacht - Sloop with a white hull and blue deck.' On Model Vessel, Navy blue hull gives '...with a navy blue hull and white deck.' (4) Glow: vessel lights 'This is X, X, X' and 'MAYDAY X Y'. Callsign lights 'Callsign ...' and 'MAYDAY X Y'. A partial MMSI lights nothing. 9 digits lights 'Callsign ZMA123, MMSI 512345678' and the static 'State Call Sign MMSI number...' line. Ticking No MMSI lights the same two lines; unticking lights nothing. POB via the pencil plus typing 4 lights the POB line, which reads 'There are 4 persons...'. Clearing a field, opening a pencil only, and the shore name and No shore contact inputs light nothing. Every glow ended after 5s. (5) Status: it read 'MAYDAY is set up' only with everything done. Clearing the boat type turned it back off. With deck_colour emptied in the DB and everything else done, Welcome showed the setup button, not welcome-mayday-done, until deck Confirm was clicked. After that, welcome-mayday-done appeared. After a reload, Additional details showed boat-type-select 'Yacht - Sloop' and hull-colour-select / deck-colour-select 'White'. (6) Regressions checked: tick/pencil fields, MMSI digits only, No MMSI and No shore contact hide their fields, and mayday-btn, panpan-btn and gps-position glow while the Welcome MAYDAY line shows and stop once it is set up. The MAYDAY list (mayday-btn) shows the updated line 'There are 4 persons on board POB. The boat is a white Yacht - Sloop.' scrollWidth stays 390 (no horizontal overflow) on Welcome, the dialog and Model Vessel. Not retested this round: the crew window shore prefill. All changed fields on test-user-pro main and model_vessel were put back from a backup, with boat_ts bumped to now, and last_boat=main.

issues: Before confirming, the Hull/Deck colour select shares half the row with the Confirm button, so it shows 'Whit' (cut off). Consider putting Confirm under the select, or making the select wider on mobile.

The lit POB/description line (line 11) is below the fold when the skipper confirms a colour, changes boat type or POB, so the 5s glow is usually not seen without scrolling. Consider scrolling the lit line into view, or a short 'see line 11' hint.

action_items: Optional UX: stop the colour select being cut off ('Whit') next to the Confirm button at 390px
Optional UX: scroll the lit MAYDAY line into view (scrollIntoView with block 'nearest') when a field change lights it, as the POB/description line sits below the fold on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: If the skipper confirms only one colour, ColourSetup/displayLabel treat the other as white and drop the NOTE. For example, hull White with deck still unconfirmed reads 'a white Yacht - Sloop' before the deck is confirmed. Acceptable, but the NOTE could stay until both are confirmed.
Choosing 'Other...' boat type calls change() on every keystroke, so the 5s timer restarts on each key. Harmless.
ColourSetup keeps its own 'pick' state and does not resync if boat[k] changes from elsewhere (another device or Additional details) while the dialog is open. Minor.
seed_data_creation: None. Changed test-user-pro main/model_vessel boat fields during testing, then restored them from /tmp/mbp/backup_pro_boats.json (main: pob 3, pob_manual false, hull/deck '', no_mmsi/no_shore false; MV: pob_manual false, shore_name/no_mmsi/no_shore unset).
